mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM user_bgm_collection c WHERE c.remote_sync_status='PENDING' AND c.pending_payload IS NOT NULL AND c.next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_bgm_collection_sync_task t WHERE t.user_id = c.user_id AND t.subject_type = c.subject_type AND t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PARTIAL_FAILED') ) ORDER BY c.next_retry_at, c.id LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_bgm_collection c
LEFT JOIN bangumi_subject s ON s.id = c.subject_id

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.subject_id, c.subject_type, c.bgm_interest_id, c.rate, c.type, c.comment, c.tags, c.ep_status, c.vol_status, c.is_private, c.bgm_updated_at, c.sync_time, c.create_time, c.local_updated_at, c.remote_sync_status, s.name, s.name_cn, s.nsfw, s.score, s.score_details, s.`rank`, s.infobox, s.images FROM user_bgm_collection c LEFT JOIN bangumi_subject s ON s.id = c.subject_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.local_updated_at, FROM_UNIXTIME(c.bgm_updated_at)) DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

select bgm_interest_id as id, rate, type, comment, tags, ep_status, vol_status, is_private as "privately", COALESCE(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(local_updated_at), bgm_updated_at, 0) as bgm_updated_at, remote_sync_status from user_bgm_collection where user_id = #{userId} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
